result.instructions: Tools for SMS Everyone, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many SMS credits do I have left on my SMS Everyone account?"; "Did anyone reply to our texts today?"; "Show the delivery status of campaign 11967215.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SMS Everyone data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run smseveryone_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run smseveryone_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run smseveryone_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. smseveryone_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: smseveryone_get_account
tools.title: Get account settings and credits
tools.description: Show the SMS Everyone account: user id, remaining SMS credits, whether unicode (emoji, non-English text) is enabled and whether international messaging is allowed. SMS Everyone REST: POST /api/RetrieveUserSettings.

tools.name: smseveryone_get_campaign_status
tools.title: Get campaign status
tools.description: Show whether a sent or scheduled campaign is Scheduled, Running, Paused or Deleted. SMS Everyone REST: POST /api/campaign with Action status.

campaign_id.description: The CampaignId SMS Everyone returned when the message was sent or scheduled.

tools.name: smseveryone_get_delivery_status
tools.title: Get delivery status
tools.description: Delivery receipts of a campaign: one entry per destination with a timestamp, a DeliveryReceiptStatusId and a carrier code. Pass destination to see one number only. An empty list means no receipt has arrived yet (carriers can take up to 24 hours) or the campaign id is not on this account. SMS Everyone asks for no more than one request per minute in production. SMS Everyone REST: POST /api/DRStatus.

campaign_id.description: The CampaignId SMS Everyone returned when the message was sent or scheduled.

destination.description: Optional single phone number in international format, e.g. 61400123456.

limit.description: Show at most this many destinations, default 500.

offset.description: Skip this many entries (for paging: use next_offset of the previous result). Default 0.

tools.name: smseveryone_list_replies
tools.title: List SMS replies
tools.description: List SMS replies received on the account: received time, the sender's number (Originator), the account number it was sent to (Recipient), the text and a reference id. Always asks for a time window (the last `days` days, 1 to 7, counted back to 12am yesterday for 1, or a date range of at most 30 days), which leaves the replies available for later calls. Default: days 1. Production polling is limited to once per minute per account through this MCP; five minutes is recommended. SMS Everyone REST: POST /api/replies.

days.description: The last N days, 1 to 7 (1 = back to 12am yesterday in the account's time zone). Default 1. Ignored when date_start is given. For longer periods use date_start/date_end (up to 30 days).

date_end.description: End date, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today). Needs date_start.

limit.description: Show at most this many replies, default 100.

offset.description: Skip this many entries (for paging: use next_offset of the previous result). Default 0.

tools.name: smseveryone_list_optouts
tools.title: List opted-out numbers
tools.description: List phone numbers in the account's optout database (messages to them are never sent): number, date added, reason. The API returns the whole list; this tool shows the first `limit` entries and the total. SMS Everyone REST: POST /api/optouts with Action list.

limit.description: Show at most this many entries, default 200.

offset.description: Skip this many entries (for paging: use next_offset of the previous result). Default 0.

tools.name: smseveryone_list_contact_lists
tools.title: List contact lists
tools.description: List the stored lists (CRM groups) of mobile numbers: list id (CrmId), description and number count. SMS Everyone REST: POST /api/crm with Action list.

limit.description: Show at most this many lists, default 500.

offset.description: Skip this many entries (for paging: use next_offset of the previous result). Default 0.

tools.name: smseveryone_get_contact_list
tools.title: Get the numbers in a contact list
tools.description: Show the mobile numbers stored in one list. The API returns the whole list; this tool shows the first `limit` numbers and the total count. SMS Everyone REST: POST /api/crm with Action details.

limit.description: Show at most this many numbers, default 200.

offset.description: Skip this many entries (for paging: use next_offset of the previous result). Default 0.

annotations.title: Get the numbers in a contact list

tools.name: smseveryone_send_sms
tools.title: Send SMS
tools.description: WRITE: SENDS REAL SMS to real people and SPENDS CREDITS from the user's SMS Everyone account; a sent message cannot be recalled (a campaign scheduled for later can be cancelled with cancel_campaign). One message text to 1 to 25 phone numbers in international format without "+" (e.g. 61400123456 for Australia, 6421123456 for New Zealand). Cost = credits per part x number of parts x recipients: a text is 160 characters per part (153 when longer), and one emoji or non-English character makes it unicode: 70 characters per part (67 when longer), more credits. Numbers on the account's optout list are skipped. The originator is where the message appears to come from and must be one registered with SMS Everyone for the account (an Australian alphanumeric sender must be ACMA registered). Optional time_scheduled (YYYYMMDDHHmm in the account's time zone; a time in the past sends at once). Only send what the user explicitly asked for; confirm the text, recipients and sender first. No stored lists, no bulk. SMS Everyone REST: POST /api/campaign with Action create.

confirm.description: Must be true only after the user confirms this exact write and its affected recipients/campaign.

originator.description: Sender: the registered originator exactly as SMS Everyone gave it (a mobile number without +, a 4 to 6 digit short code, or a registered alphanumeric name; names are case sensitive).

destinations.description: 1 to 25 recipient numbers in international format with country code, no leading 0, e.g. 61400123456.

message.description: The message text (long texts are split into several parts and cost more).

time_scheduled.description: Optional send time YYYYMMDDHHmm in the account's time zone, e.g. 203507301300 = 30 July 2035, 1pm. Omit to send now.

tools.name: smseveryone_cancel_campaign
tools.title: Cancel a scheduled campaign
tools.description: WRITE: deletes a scheduled SMS campaign so it is not sent. Only works before the campaign start time (afterwards SMS Everyone refuses it with an error code). It cannot be undone. SMS Everyone REST: POST /api/campaign with Action delete.

campaign_id.description: The CampaignId SMS Everyone returned when the message was sent or scheduled.

confirm.description: Must be true only after the user confirms this exact write and its affected recipients/campaign.

tools.name: smseveryone_pause_campaign
tools.title: Pause a campaign
tools.description: WRITE: pauses a scheduled campaign (or one that is sending; SMS Everyone sends over 1000 messages a second, so a running campaign usually finishes first). A campaign scheduled in the past cannot be paused. This server has no way to resume it: the user must do that in SMS Everyone. SMS Everyone REST: POST /api/campaign with Action pause.

campaign_id.description: The CampaignId SMS Everyone returned when the message was sent or scheduled.

confirm.description: Must be true only after the user confirms this exact write and its affected recipients/campaign.

tools.name: smseveryone_add_optouts
tools.title: Opt numbers out
tools.description: WRITE: adds 1 to 25 phone numbers to the account's optout database, so no later campaign is sent to them. This server cannot opt a number back in. Do it only when the user asks. SMS Everyone REST: POST /api/optouts with Action add.

confirm.description: Must be true only after the user confirms this exact write and its affected recipients/campaign.
